reason: Conversation 1 refused to engage at all and pointed the homeowner to an engineer, which the ground truth marks as unsupported, leaving a worried owner with no reassurance about a normal skin-condenser design. Conversation 2 correctly explained that the condenser is built into the side panels, ruled out burning smell and tripping, gathered the alcove clearance and model number, and gave appropriate ventilation guidance without recommending a part. It loses some credit for an odd 'switch it off and unplug it' preamble, the dubious coin-spacer tilt suggestion, never asking the internal temperatures, and hinting the unit might be 'defective', but it still served the homeowner far better than a blanket refusal.
